title: Concept: vcpkg version override
description: vcpkg.json declares an `overrides` entry that forces one port version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `overrides` entry that forces one port version.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through vcpkg.json (vcpkg).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `overrides` entry that forces one port version.
